levels.label: Semantic contract diff
levels.allowed_claim: Two OpenAPI 3.x documents can produce bounded addition, removal, response-change, and deprecation records.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every runtime or undocumented consumer impact has been found.

levels.label: Certainty/policy separation
levels.allowed_claim: Certainty and policy consequence remain separate, with explicit human dispositions and no merge/release verdict.
levels.forbidden_inference: A change marked breaking automatically blocks or approves release.

levels.label: Review/deletion handoff
levels.allowed_claim: The receipt leaves a source-linked seam for downstream review tools.
levels.forbidden_inference: Review Attention Map or Deletion Proof has consumed this exact receipt.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The contract case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
